entries.en: The discussion explored how communities can resist political extremism.
entries.zh: 讨论探讨了社区可以如何抵制政治极端主义。

entries.en: Penelope packed a sketchbook for the overnight train journey.
entries.zh: 佩内洛普为那趟夜间火车旅程带上了一本速写本。

entries.meaningZh: 首相或总理的任期、职位
entries.en: Her premiership began during a period of economic uncertainty.
entries.zh: 她的首相任期开始于一段经济前景不明朗的时期。

entries.en: The festival featured Jamaican musicians alongside local jazz bands.
entries.zh: 音乐节邀请了牙买加音乐家以及当地爵士乐队演出。

entries.en: Clouds hid the hills of Skye during our visit.
entries.zh: 我们到访时，斯凯岛的山丘隐没在云中。

entries.en: The finder returned the lost necklace to the information desk.
entries.zh: 拾得者把丢失的项链交回了服务台。

entries.en: The hooper fitted a new metal band around the barrel.
entries.zh: 箍桶匠给木桶套上了一个新的金属箍。

entries.en: The proposed nationalisation of the railway divided parliament.
entries.zh: 铁路国有化的提议使议会产生了分歧。

entries.en: The lemon tart was the standout on the dessert menu.
entries.zh: 柠檬挞是甜点菜单上最出彩的一款。

entries.en: He kept his checkbook in a locked desk drawer.
entries.zh: 他把支票簿放在上锁的书桌抽屉里。

entries.meaningZh: 狭海峡；水道（苏格兰用语）
entries.en: The fishing boat crossed the kyle before the tide turned.
entries.zh: 渔船在潮水转向前穿过了那条狭海峡。

entries.en: The singer repeated the melody an octave lower.
entries.zh: 歌手把旋律降低一个八度又唱了一遍。

entries.en: The biology lesson explained fertilization using a flower diagram.
entries.zh: 生物课用一幅花的示意图讲解了受精过程。

entries.meaningZh: 伤残调整生命年（disability-adjusted life year，衡量健康寿命损失的指标）
entries.en: The study estimated the cost per DALY averted.
entries.zh: 这项研究估算了每避免一个伤残调整生命年损失所需的成本。

entries.en: Rica brought extra batteries for the recording equipment.
entries.zh: 丽卡给录音设备带来了备用电池。

entries.meaningZh: 不偏向任何党派的；无党派倾向的
entries.en: A nonpartisan group organised the public debate on transport.
entries.zh: 一个无党派倾向的团体组织了有关交通的公开辩论。

entries.en: We admired the snow-covered peaks from afar.
entries.zh: 我们从远处欣赏那些白雪覆盖的山峰。

entries.en: The diagram traced arterial blood flow through the arm.
entries.zh: 示意图展示了动脉血流经手臂的路线。

entries.en: Cracks in the road raised concerns about subsidence.
entries.zh: 路面的裂缝引发了人们对地面下沉的担忧。

entries.en: Randolph repaired the loose hinge before opening the shop.
entries.zh: 伦道夫在开店前修好了松动的铰链。

entries.en: Manuel translated the instructions for the visiting students.
entries.zh: 曼努埃尔为来访学生翻译了那些说明。

entries.en: An orchestral arrangement gave the familiar song a different character.
entries.zh: 管弦乐编曲使这首熟悉的歌呈现出不同的风格。

entries.en: Nolan marked the damaged boxes with red tape.
entries.zh: 诺兰用红色胶带标记了受损的箱子。

entries.en: The joke relies on the hearer recognising a familiar phrase.
entries.zh: 这个笑话能否奏效，取决于听者能否认出一句熟悉的表达。

entries.en: The young harrier trained on muddy woodland trails.
entries.zh: 这位年轻的越野跑运动员在泥泞的林间小路上训练。

entries.en: Gwen reserved a quiet table near the library window.
entries.zh: 格温预订了图书馆窗边的一张安静桌子。

entries.meaningZh: 高地居民；尤指苏格兰高地人
entries.en: The memoir follows a Highlander who moves to a coastal town.
entries.zh: 这本回忆录讲述了一位苏格兰高地人搬到海滨小镇的经历。

entries.meaningZh: 观察性的；以观察为基础的
entries.en: The students kept observational notes on the birds' feeding habits.
entries.zh: 学生们记录了对鸟类进食习惯的观察笔记。

entries.en: Ms Prescott arranged the paintings in chronological order.
entries.zh: 普雷斯科特女士按年代顺序排列了那些画作。

entries.en: The laboratory tested the soil samples for cadmium.
entries.zh: 实验室检测了土壤样本中的镉。

entries.en: Muhammad volunteered to guide the visitors through the exhibition.
entries.zh: 穆罕默德自愿带领访客参观展览。

entries.meaningZh: 取笑（用于take the micky out of；mickey的较少见拼写，英式口语）
entries.en: My cousins kept taking the micky out of my haircut.
entries.zh: 我的表亲们不停地拿我的发型开玩笑。

entries.en: The engineer adjusted the grip of the prosthetic hand.
entries.zh: 工程师调整了假手的抓握功能。

entries.en: The museum displayed Ottoman ceramics beside several handwritten maps.
entries.zh: 博物馆在几幅手绘地图旁展示了奥斯曼陶瓷。

entries.en: Mona folded the fabric before cutting out the pattern.
entries.zh: 莫娜先把布料折好，再按纸样裁剪。

entries.meaningZh: 个性化的；按个人需要定制的
entries.en: Each runner received a personalized plan for the next month.
entries.zh: 每位跑步者都得到了一份为自己定制的下月训练计划。

entries.en: Nellie hid the birthday present behind a stack of cushions.
entries.zh: 内莉把生日礼物藏在一摞靠垫后面。

entries.meaningZh: 玛丽安（法国共和国的女性象征）
entries.en: A statue of Marianne stood beside the town hall.
entries.zh: 市政厅旁矗立着一尊象征法国共和国的玛丽安雕像。

entries.meaningZh: 清算人；负责公司清算者
entries.en: The liquidator prepared an inventory of the company's remaining assets.
entries.zh: 清算人编制了一份公司剩余资产清单。

entries.meaningZh: 青酱；以罗勒等制成的调味酱
entries.en: She stirred a spoonful of pesto into the warm pasta.
entries.zh: 她把一勺青酱拌进温热的意大利面里。

entries.en: The witness helped police identify the suspected kidnapper.
entries.zh: 目击者帮助警方辨认了涉嫌绑架的人。

entries.en: The proof establishes the equivalence of the two conditions.
entries.zh: 这个证明确立了两个条件之间的等价关系。

entries.meaningZh: 多维的；涉及多个方面的
entries.en: The team used a multidimensional model to describe consumer preferences.
entries.zh: 团队用一个多维模型来描述消费者的偏好。

entries.en: Both parties agreed to submit the dispute for adjudication.
entries.zh: 双方同意将争议提交裁决。

entries.en: The research vessel collected data on oceanic currents.
entries.zh: 科考船收集了有关洋流的数据。

entries.en: Zoe sorted the old photographs by date.
entries.zh: 佐伊按日期整理了那些老照片。

entries.en: Garrett measured the doorway before ordering the new cabinet.
entries.zh: 加勒特在订购新柜子前测量了门口的尺寸。

entries.meaningZh: 计算的；涉及计算方法的
entries.en: The larger dataset increased the computational cost of the analysis.
entries.zh: 更大的数据集增加了分析的计算成本。

entries.en: The article distinguishes statistical association from causation.
entries.zh: 这篇文章区分了统计关联与因果关系。

entries.en: The technician will configure the router for the new office.
entries.zh: 技术人员将为新办公室配置路由器。

entries.en: She glanced uncertainly at the unfamiliar control panel.
entries.zh: 她犹疑地看了一眼不熟悉的控制面板。

entries.en: Dr Haynes annotated the map during the field trip.
entries.zh: 海恩斯博士在野外考察时给地图作了注释。

entries.meaningZh: 色情的；涉及色情内容的
entries.en: The library's public computers block access to pornographic websites.
entries.zh: 图书馆的公用电脑阻止访问色情网站。

entries.en: Stefan practised the difficult passage at a slower tempo.
entries.zh: 斯特凡用较慢的速度练习那段难演奏的乐句。

entries.en: Abdul checked that every bicycle had a working rear light.
entries.zh: 阿卜杜勒检查了每辆自行车的尾灯是否都能正常使用。

entries.en: Jessie wrapped the broken handle in a soft cloth.
entries.zh: 杰西用软布包住了断裂的把手。

entries.en: Theo noticed a second signature beneath the faded inscription.
entries.zh: 西奥注意到褪色的题字下面还有一个签名。

entries.en: Klaus fitted a rain cover over the camera.
entries.zh: 克劳斯给相机套上了防雨罩。

entries.en: Years of financial mismanagement left the club in debt.
entries.zh: 多年的财务管理不善使俱乐部负债。

entries.en: The seminar examined a psychoanalytic interpretation of the novel.
entries.zh: 研讨课探讨了对这部小说的一种精神分析式解读。

entries.meaningZh: 仿佛施了魔法般地；神奇地
entries.en: A fresh coat of paint magically transformed the gloomy room.
entries.zh: 刷上一层新油漆后，昏暗的房间神奇地焕然一新。

entries.en: Mr Hodge donated his collection of local railway photographs.
entries.zh: 霍奇先生捐出了自己收藏的当地铁路照片。

entries.en: Luis found a shaded spot for the picnic.
entries.zh: 路易斯找到了一个适合野餐的阴凉地方。

entries.en: The wiry climber moved quickly up the steep rock face.
entries.zh: 那位瘦而结实的攀登者迅速攀上陡峭的岩壁。

entries.en: Connie added handwritten labels to the jars of jam.
entries.zh: 康妮给那些果酱罐贴上了手写标签。

entries.en: A geneticist joined the team studying inherited eye conditions.
entries.zh: 一位遗传学家加入了研究遗传性眼病的团队。

entries.meaningZh: 庞然大物；规模极大的机构或事物
entries.en: The tiny publisher struggled to compete with a media behemoth.
entries.zh: 这家小出版社很难与一家媒体巨头竞争。

entries.meaningZh: 脾气火爆的人（非正式用语）
entries.en: The play's young heroine is a fearless little spitfire.
entries.zh: 这部戏的年轻女主角是个无所畏惧、脾气火爆的小姑娘。

entries.en: Nah, I would rather walk than wait for another bus.
entries.zh: 不了，我宁愿走路，也不想再等一班公交车。

entries.en: Dora threaded the needle without taking off her gloves.
entries.zh: 多拉没有摘下手套就把线穿过了针眼。

entries.en: Louisa searched the programme for her friend's name.
entries.zh: 路易莎在节目单上寻找朋友的名字。

entries.meaningZh: 形态学的；涉及形态结构的
entries.en: The botanists compared morphological differences between the two specimens.
entries.zh: 植物学家比较了两个标本在形态上的差异。

entries.meaningZh: 乘数；乘法运算中的因数
entries.en: Change the multiplier from three to five and calculate again.
entries.zh: 把乘数从三改为五，再算一次。

entries.en: The court postponed the extradition hearing until next month.
entries.zh: 法院把引渡听证会推迟到了下个月。

entries.en: Professor Wang compared the students' sketches with the original plans.
entries.zh: 王教授把学生们的草图与原始方案作了比较。

entries.en: A garden sprinkler sprayed water across the dry lawn.
entries.zh: 花园洒水器把水喷洒到干燥的草坪上。

entries.meaningZh: 以化学方式；在化学性质上
entries.en: The two liquids look similar but behave differently chemically.
entries.zh: 这两种液体看起来相似，但化学性质方面的表现不同。

entries.en: The deleted photographs were still recoverable from the backup drive.
entries.zh: 被删除的照片仍可以从备份硬盘中找回。

entries.en: The address on the old postcard ended with West Yorks.
entries.zh: 那张旧明信片上的地址以西约克郡的缩写结尾。

entries.meaningZh: 失禁；排泄控制能力丧失
entries.en: The nurse discussed how incontinence affected his daily routine.
entries.zh: 护士与他讨论了失禁对日常生活的影响。

entries.meaningZh: 阿姨；姑妈等女性长辈的亲昵称呼
entries.en: My aunty knitted a bright scarf for the school fair.
entries.zh: 我阿姨为学校义卖会织了一条鲜艳的围巾。

entries.en: The public health team explained how syphilis screening works.
entries.zh: 公共卫生团队讲解了梅毒筛查的流程。

entries.meaningZh: 国有化的；由国家拥有或控制的
entries.en: Workers at the nationalized company requested a new pay agreement.
entries.zh: 那家国有化公司的员工要求达成新的薪酬协议。

entries.en: The archive contains family photographs taken in Gaza.
entries.zh: 档案中保存着一些在加沙拍摄的家庭照片。

entries.en: A short beep signalled that the recording had ended.
entries.zh: 一声短促的哔声表示录音已经结束。

entries.en: Ms Truman submitted a revised design for the footbridge.
entries.zh: 特鲁曼女士提交了一份修订后的人行桥设计方案。

entries.en: A narrow path led into a quiet, wooded dell.
entries.zh: 一条狭窄的小路通向一处宁静、林木茂密的小山谷。

entries.en: Dr Chen presented the team's findings at the workshop.
entries.zh: 陈博士在研讨会上介绍了团队的研究结果。

entries.meaningZh: 学徒（旧式用语，apprentice的缩略形式）
entries.en: The young prentice swept the workshop before the master arrived.
entries.zh: 年轻的学徒在师傅到来前打扫了作坊。

entries.en: The experiment measured the retardation of the rotating disc.
entries.zh: 实验测量了旋转圆盘的减速情况。

entries.en: Strong coastal winds made windsurfing difficult for the beginners.
entries.zh: 强劲的海风使初学者难以进行帆板运动。

entries.en: He seems constitutionally unable to leave an unfinished puzzle alone.
entries.zh: 他仿佛天生就无法对没解完的谜题置之不理。

entries.en: The contract named his uncle as the surety.
entries.zh: 合同指定他的叔叔为担保人。

entries.en: She stared blankly at the question on the screen.
entries.zh: 她茫然地盯着屏幕上的问题。

entries.meaningZh: 模式化的；基于刻板印象的
entries.en: The film avoids the stereotypical image of the absent-minded scientist.
entries.zh: 这部电影避开了那种心不在焉的科学家刻板形象。

entries.meaningZh: 共同凑集的钱；公用资金（非正式用语）
entries.en: Everyone put a few coins into the kitty for snacks.
entries.zh: 大家各拿出几枚硬币，凑在一起买零食。

entries.meaningZh: 争吵；吵闹（英式非正式用语）
entries.en: They had a barney over who should wash the dishes.
entries.zh: 他们为谁该洗碗吵了一架。

entries.meaningZh: 塔拉（爱尔兰的历史遗址，亦称塔拉山）
entries.en: The guide showed us an old map of Tara.
entries.zh: 导游给我们看了一张塔拉的旧地图。

entries.en: She held the tiller steady as the dinghy crossed the bay.
entries.zh: 小帆船横穿海湾时，她稳稳地握住舵柄。

entries.en: The reform promoted decentralization by giving local offices more authority.
entries.zh: 这项改革通过赋予地方办事机构更多权力来推进分权。

entries.en: The old door stubbornly refused to open in the damp weather.
entries.zh: 潮湿的天气里，那扇旧门怎么也打不开。

entries.meaningZh: 极粗俗、具有冒犯性的辱骂用语（不宜使用）
entries.en: The witness objected when a stranger called him a cunt.
entries.zh: 一个陌生人用极粗俗的脏话辱骂他时，证人提出了抗议。

entries.meaningZh: 痴迷于某个领域的人；极客（非正式用语）
entries.en: As a photography geek, she notices every change in lighting.
entries.zh: 作为一名摄影发烧友，她会留意光线的每一处变化。

entries.en: She reviews property reports as part of the underwriting process.
entries.zh: 她审核房产报告，这是核保流程的一部分。

entries.en: Mr Whitaker restored the faded lettering above the shop entrance.
entries.zh: 惠特克先生修复了店铺入口上方褪色的字迹。

entries.meaningZh: 档案的；与档案保存有关的
entries.en: The documentary combines interviews with archival footage of the town.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片把访谈与小镇的档案影像结合起来。

entries.en: Sherman sketched the coastline from the top of the lighthouse.
entries.zh: 谢尔曼在灯塔顶部勾画了海岸线。

entries.en: The conservation plan focuses on the eradication of invasive weeds.
entries.zh: 这项保护计划着重于彻底清除入侵杂草。

entries.en: Ms Wilcox compared the fabric samples in natural light.
entries.zh: 威尔科克斯女士在自然光下比较了那些布料样品。

entries.en: An actuary compared claim patterns across several age groups.
entries.zh: 一位精算师比较了几个年龄组的索赔模式。

entries.meaningZh: 戈德堡（姓氏；原词库的歧视性释义另待核对）
entries.en: The editor questioned the entry for Goldberg in the glossary.
entries.zh: 编辑对术语表中的Goldberg词条提出了疑问。

entries.en: Our exhibition in Lima attracted visitors from several countries.
entries.zh: 我们在利马的展览吸引了来自几个国家的观众。

entries.en: Residents vehemently opposed the closure of their local library.
entries.zh: 居民强烈反对关闭当地的图书馆。

entries.en: Ella checked the tide times before arranging the coastal walk.
entries.zh: 埃拉在安排海边徒步前查看了潮汐时间。

entries.en: The graph shows cyclic changes in the lake's water level.
entries.zh: 图表显示了湖水水位的周期性变化。

entries.en: Morning light poured through the skylight above the staircase.
entries.zh: 晨光从楼梯上方的天窗倾泻而入。

entries.en: The slight asymmetry of the vase reveals its handmade origin.
entries.zh: 花瓶略微不对称，显露出手工制作的痕迹。

entries.meaningZh: 仿真；对另一系统运行方式的模拟
entries.en: The software uses emulation to run older games.
entries.zh: 这个软件通过仿真来运行较老的游戏。

entries.meaningZh: 会吏长；教会中协助主教的高级神职人员
entries.en: The archdeacon visited three rural parishes that week.
entries.zh: 会吏长那一周走访了三个乡村教区。

entries.en: The historical record documents his committal to prison.
entries.zh: 这份历史记录记载了他被送入监狱的情况。

entries.en: Olivia placed a bookmark beside the passage she wanted to quote.
entries.zh: 奥利维娅在想引用的段落旁放了一张书签。

entries.meaningZh: 上流社交界；时髦社交圈（法语借词，文学用语）
entries.en: She moved easily through the fashionable monde of the capital.
entries.zh: 她在首都时髦的社交圈中游刃有余。

entries.meaningZh: 内部通话系统；对讲装置
entries.en: The caretaker answered the visitor through the intercom.
entries.zh: 管理员通过对讲装置回应了来访者。

entries.meaningZh: 最低限度地；尽可能少地
entries.en: The editor changed the manuscript only minimally.
entries.zh: 编辑只对手稿作了极少的修改。

entries.en: The bookshop expanded its YA section after requests from teenage readers.
entries.zh: 应青少年读者要求，书店扩大了青少年文学专区。

entries.en: The scan showed a shoulder dislocation after the fall.
entries.zh: 扫描显示，摔倒后出现了肩关节脱臼。

entries.meaningZh: 在音乐方面；从音乐角度而言
entries.en: The two sisters are equally gifted musically.
entries.zh: 这两姐妹在音乐方面同样有天赋。

entries.meaningZh: 英国皇家防止虐待动物协会（RSPCA）
entries.en: The injured fox was taken into the care of the RSPCA.
entries.zh: 那只受伤的狐狸被交给英国皇家防止虐待动物协会照料。

entries.meaningZh: 母亲（主要用于英式英语，旧式或诙谐用语）
entries.en: We spent the long weekend visiting the mater.
entries.zh: 我们利用长周末去看望了母亲。

entries.meaningZh: 西比尔（女子名；勿与普通名词sibyl混淆）
entries.en: Sybil carefully unwrapped the package of antique postcards.
entries.zh: 西比尔小心地拆开了那包古旧明信片。

entries.en: She wound the loose wool into a neat hank.
entries.zh: 她把松散的羊毛线绕成了整齐的一绞。

entries.en: The choir rehearsed liturgical music for the evening service.
entries.zh: 唱诗班为晚间礼拜排练了礼仪音乐。

entries.en: The dispatcher sent a repair crew to the damaged bridge.
entries.zh: 调度员派出了一支维修队前往受损的桥梁。

entries.meaningZh: 芽体；无性繁殖芽（植物学用语）
entries.en: The student examined a single gemma under the microscope.
entries.zh: 学生用显微镜观察了一个无性繁殖芽。

entries.en: Accurate segmentation separates the image into meaningful regions.
entries.zh: 准确的分割将图像划分成有意义的区域。

entries.meaningZh: 玻璃纤维；玻璃纤维材料（美式拼写）
entries.en: The lightweight boat has a hull made of fiberglass.
entries.zh: 这艘轻型船的船体由玻璃纤维材料制成。

entries.en: Dr Markham photographed the stone fragments before moving them.
entries.zh: 马卡姆博士在移动石块碎片前给它们拍了照。

entries.en: Please dispose of the old batteries responsibly.
entries.zh: 请以负责任的方式处理旧电池。

entries.meaningZh: 舰上的禁闭室；军事监禁处所
entries.en: The sailor spent the night in the ship's brig.
entries.zh: 那名水手在舰上的禁闭室过了一夜。

entries.en: The abandoned station was eerily silent after sunset.
entries.zh: 日落后，废弃的车站寂静得令人不安。

entries.meaningZh: 扳平比分的一球（英式拼写）
entries.en: The striker scored a late equaliser in the final minutes.
entries.zh: 前锋在比赛最后几分钟攻入了扳平比分的一球。

entries.en: The report examines macroeconomic trends rather than individual firms.
entries.zh: 这份报告考察的是宏观经济趋势，而非个别企业。

entries.meaningZh: 疯癫的；发疯的（非正式用语）
entries.en: That endless drilling noise is driving me loco.
entries.zh: 那没完没了的钻孔声快把我逼疯了。

entries.meaningZh: 纤维化；纤维组织异常增生
entries.en: The medical team investigated signs of fibrosis in the tissue sample.
entries.zh: 医疗团队检查了组织样本中是否存在纤维化迹象。

entries.en: The freight train waited on a siding while passengers boarded nearby.
entries.zh: 货运列车停在侧线上等待，附近的乘客正在上车。

entries.en: A dense privet hedge sheltered the garden from the road.
entries.zh: 一道浓密的女贞绿篱将花园与道路隔开。

entries.meaningZh: 臭骂；严厉斥责（英式粗俗口语）
entries.en: The supervisor would bollock anyone who ignored the safety barriers.
entries.zh: 主管会狠狠训斥任何无视安全隔离栏的人。

entries.en: Reconnect the cable once the replacement monitor is in position.
entries.zh: 更换后的显示器放好后，再把线缆接上。

entries.en: Seth traced the water leak to a cracked pipe.
entries.zh: 塞思查明漏水来自一根破裂的管道。

entries.meaningZh: 古怪的；有些疯癫的（非正式用语）
entries.en: My neighbours thought the elaborate garden maze was a batty idea.
entries.zh: 邻居们觉得，在花园里建复杂迷宫是个古怪的主意。

entries.meaningZh: 略带褐色的（较少见用语）
entries.en: A browny tint appeared around the edge of the leaf.
entries.zh: 叶片边缘出现了淡淡的褐色。

entries.en: He folded the warm crepe around a spoonful of berries.
entries.zh: 他把温热的薄煎饼折起来，包住一勺浆果。

entries.en: He replied crossly when I interrupted his reading.
entries.zh: 我打断他读书时，他没好气地作了回答。

entries.en: The operator checked the temperature reading on the HMI.
entries.zh: 操作员查看了人机界面上的温度读数。

entries.en: The travel journal includes sketches of markets in Tehran.
entries.zh: 这本旅行日记中有一些德黑兰集市的速写。

entries.en: The valet brought our car to the hotel entrance.
entries.zh: 代客泊车员把我们的车开到了酒店门口。

entries.meaningZh: 麦西亚（早期英格兰的王国）
entries.en: The history class studied a map of medieval Mercia.
entries.zh: 历史课研究了一幅中世纪麦西亚的地图。

entries.meaningZh: 州长的；与州长职位有关的
entries.en: Several candidates joined the televised gubernatorial debate.
entries.zh: 几位候选人参加了电视转播的州长竞选辩论。

entries.en: She irritably waved away the fly near her face.
entries.zh: 她烦躁地挥手赶走了脸旁的苍蝇。

entries.meaningZh: 按重要性排序；优先处理
entries.en: We need to prioritize urgent repairs before repainting the building.
entries.zh: 我们需要先处理紧急维修，再给建筑重新刷漆。

entries.meaningZh: 指称对象；词语所指的人或事物
entries.en: The pronoun's referent becomes clear in the next sentence.
entries.zh: 这个代词所指的对象在下一句中变得明确。

entries.en: Millie spotted the missing button beneath the sewing table.
entries.zh: 米莉在缝纫桌下发现了丢失的纽扣。

entries.meaningZh: 壁炉架；壁炉上方的台面
entries.en: Two framed photographs stood on the mantel above the fireplace.
entries.zh: 壁炉上方的壁炉架上摆着两张装框的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 联想的；由事物之间的联系产生的
entries.en: The experiment explored associative links between colours and emotions.
entries.zh: 实验探讨了颜色与情绪之间的联想联系。

entries.meaningZh: 教皇职位；教皇统治时期或制度
entries.en: The course traces changes in the papacy over several centuries.
entries.zh: 这门课追溯了几个世纪以来教皇制度的变化。

entries.meaningZh: 本体论的；有关存在本质的
entries.en: The essay raises ontological questions about fictional characters.
entries.zh: 这篇文章提出了有关虚构人物存在本质的本体论问题。

entries.en: The workshop runs from Mon to Fri.
entries.zh: 培训班从周一持续到周五。

entries.en: The exhibition features beadwork made by Sioux artists.
entries.zh: 展览展出了苏族艺术家制作的珠饰作品。

entries.en: Ms Templeton supervised the restoration of the stone steps.
entries.zh: 坦普尔顿女士监督了石阶的修复工作。

entries.en: Josie arranged the chairs in a circle for the discussion.
entries.zh: 乔西为讨论会把椅子摆成了一圈。

entries.meaningZh: 学习管理系统（learning management system）
entries.en: The lecturer uploaded the reading list to the LMS.
entries.zh: 讲师把阅读书目上传到了学习管理系统。

entries.en: A functionalist might examine how the institution maintains social stability.
entries.zh: 功能主义者可能会考察这一制度如何维持社会稳定。

entries.meaningZh: 侦探（旧式俚语，detective的缩略形式）
entries.en: The tec questioned the porter about the missing suitcase.
entries.zh: 侦探就丢失的手提箱询问了搬运工。

entries.en: The volunteer carried a clipboard with the list of arrivals.
entries.zh: 志愿者拿着一块夹有到场人员名单的写字板。

entries.meaningZh: 信托的；涉及受托责任的
entries.en: The lecture examined fiduciary duties in several legal systems.
entries.zh: 这堂课探讨了几个法律制度中的信义义务。

entries.en: The textbook distinguishes excretion from the removal of undigested food.
entries.zh: 教材区分了排泄与排出未消化食物这两个过程。

entries.en: Ms Holman organised a neighbourhood book exchange.
entries.zh: 霍尔曼女士组织了一次邻里图书交换活动。

entries.meaningZh: 便服；军人非执勤时穿的普通衣服
entries.en: The soldiers wore mufti during their day in town.
entries.zh: 士兵们在城里度过那一天时穿着便服。

entries.meaningZh: 兄弟或姐妹（常见于遗传学等专业语境）
entries.en: The study compared each participant with an unaffected sib.
entries.zh: 研究将每位参与者与其未受影响的一位兄弟或姐妹作了比较。

entries.en: The reaction began when the technician added the activator.
entries.zh: 技术人员加入活化剂后，反应开始了。

entries.en: A young chimp watched the keeper from behind a branch.
entries.zh: 一只年幼的黑猩猩从树枝后面望着饲养员。

entries.meaningZh: 小龙虾（澳新口语，crayfish的简称）
entries.en: A cray hid beneath a flat stone in the stream.
entries.zh: 一只小龙虾藏在溪流中的一块扁平石头下。

entries.meaningZh: 分散管理的；去中心化的
entries.en: A decentralized network does not rely on a single central server.
entries.zh: 去中心化网络不依赖单一的中央服务器。

entries.meaningZh: 极端主义者；激进派成员
entries.en: The ultras rejected any compromise with the rival faction.
entries.zh: 激进派成员拒绝与对立派别作出任何妥协。

entries.meaningZh: 累加器（计算机或运算装置中的部件）
entries.en: The processor stored the intermediate result in the accumulator.
entries.zh: 处理器把中间结果存入累加器。

entries.en: A senna bush with yellow flowers grew beside the path.
entries.zh: 小路旁长着一丛开黄花的番泻树。

entries.meaningZh: 熵（此处指信息的不确定性度量）
entries.en: The lecture used coin tosses to illustrate information entropy.
entries.zh: 这堂课用抛硬币来说明信息熵。

entries.meaningZh: 在……之下（方言或诗歌用语）
entries.en: The poet imagined a small cottage neath the ancient trees.
entries.zh: 诗人想象着古树下面的一间小屋。

entries.en: The suitcase was unbelievably heavy despite its small size.
entries.zh: 那个手提箱虽然体积小，却重得难以置信。

entries.meaningZh: 夫人；女士（德语称谓，置于姓氏前）
entries.en: Frau Keller welcomed the exchange students into her classroom.
entries.zh: 凯勒女士欢迎交换生走进她的教室。

entries.en: The researcher sought evidence to test the verity of the claim.
entries.zh: 研究者寻找证据，以核实那项说法的真实性。

entries.en: The tutor explained the rubric before students began the assignment.
entries.zh: 导师在学生开始作业前讲解了评分标准。

entries.meaningZh: 但泽（格但斯克的历史德语名称）
entries.en: The historian compared old maps of Danzig with modern street plans.
entries.zh: 历史学家把但泽的旧地图与现代街道规划图作了比较。

entries.en: She smoothed a little hand creme over her dry knuckles.
entries.zh: 她在干燥的指关节上轻轻抹了一点护手霜。

entries.en: Prost! They raised their glasses to celebrate the reunion.
entries.zh: 干杯！他们举杯庆祝重聚。

entries.meaningZh: 欧洲足球协会联盟；欧足联（UEFA）
entries.en: The journalist consulted UEFA's website before writing the football report.
entries.zh: 记者在撰写足球报道前查阅了欧足联的网站。

entries.en: The course examines postmodernism through architecture, fiction and visual art.
entries.zh: 这门课通过建筑、小说和视觉艺术来研究后现代主义。

entries.meaningZh: 最不发达国家（least developed country，联合国分类用语）
entries.en: The report compared infrastructure needs across several LDCs.
entries.zh: 报告比较了几个最不发达国家的基础设施需求。

entries.meaningZh: 待核对缩写义项（原词库列出多个互不相关的展开形式）
entries.en: The editor flagged LR for clarification in the technical glossary.
entries.zh: 编辑在技术术语表中把LR标记为需要进一步澄清的缩写。

entries.meaningZh: 水螅体；珊瑚等刺胞动物的个体形态
entries.en: A tiny coral polyp extended its tentacles into the water.
entries.zh: 一个微小的珊瑚虫把触手伸向水中。
